cases.name: read-elevation-reads-scope-field-not-property
cases.note: Chocolatey's scope is Machine when Options.Scope is absent (§manager-chocolatey), but elevation reads the Options.Scope part, which is absent. Control: read-chocolatey-scope-default-machine.

cases.name: read-elevation-ignores-scope-parameter

cases.name: read-elevation-known-when-scope-unknown
